row.body: The fish order is paired with a pond sample slip dated after the kitchen served lunch. The cook’s note says the catch was fresh.
row.title: Catch and sample slip

cites.quote: Cat on a Hot Tin Grill

sidecar.gloss: Lunch is served before the pond sample is recorded.
sidecar.rival_reading: A routine food inspection could sample the pond after lunch; the slip does not identify what prompted it.
